mechanism: After a week of flat price with unanimous upward micro-displacement and high stability (Aug 13-17), the load-bearing channel snapped in real time: late Aug 18 the displacement sign flipped negative, and on Aug 19 four channels died in one session with URF flat-lining at 0.000 in four of five readings, fragmentation jumping from ~1.88 to ~2.78, and stability sagging from 0.89 to 0.80. Price near the bottom of its recent range has not yet paid for this damage — it firmed intraday while the field was dying, so the stored tension of a freshly fragmented, unanimously down-displacing field sits above an unsupported price. In this life, death clusters of this size (2020-03, 2019-10) preceded the price roughly halving within two months; the damage here is hours old, not healed.
